mentions.description: Browser extension that adds a table of contents widget to chatbot pages (Claude, Grok, ChatGPT), making long conversations easier to navigate. Mainly used on Firefox and not tested on Chrome.
mentions.problem: Long chatbot conversations are hard to navigate.
